record.paper_title: A survey of equivariant map algebras with open problems
record.original_question: Let a be an associative bialgebra, let X be an affine scheme with coordinate algebra A, let Γ act on X and a by automorphisms, and set M = M(X,a)^Γ, the Γ-fixed subalgebra of a ⊗ A. Understand the multi-orbit evaluation representations that arise from the comultiplication on a, including their construction, classification, and structural properties.

evidence.quote: The action of Γ on X induces an action on the coordinate ring A of X. Then M = (a ⊗ A)Γ , the fixed points of the diagonal action of Γ on a ⊗ A.

4.2.4. Associative bialgebras. In the case that a is an associative bialgebra, one can naturally define multi-orbit evaluation representations using the comultiplica- tion on a. It would be interesting to understand these representations.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathfrak{a}$ be an associative bialgebra over an algebraically closed field $k$ of characteristic zero, with multiplication $\mu:\mathfrak{a}\otimes\mathfrak{a}\to\mathfrak{a}$ and comultiplication $\Delta:\mathfrak{a}\to\mathfrak{a}\otimes\mathfrak{a}$. Let $X$ be an affine scheme over $k$ with coordinate algebra $A=k[X]$, and let $\Gamma$ be a group acting by automorphisms on both $X$ (and hence on $A$) and on $\mathfrak{a}$. Define the equivariant map algebra
$$M=M(X,\mathfrak{a})^\Gamma=(\mathfrak{a}\otimes A)^\Gamma,$$
the fixed-point subalgebra of $\mathfrak{a}\otimes A$ under the diagonal $\Gamma$-action.

For a single $\Gamma$-orbit $\Gamma\cdot x\subset X$ with rational points, the evaluation map $\mathrm{ev}_{\Gamma\cdot x}:M\to\mathfrak{a}^{\Gamma_x}$ (where $\Gamma_x$ is the stabilizer) yields, by pullback, the "single-orbit evaluation representations" of $M$.

Using the comultiplication $\Delta$ of $\mathfrak{a}$, one may attempt to define multi-orbit evaluation representations of $M$ associated with a finite collection of distinct $\Gamma$-orbits $\Gamma\cdot x_1,\dots,\Gamma\cdot x_n$ in $X$ and irreducible representations $V_i$ of $\mathfrak{a}^{\Gamma_{x_i}}$, by tensoring evaluations through iterated coproducts.

Carry out the following:
(a) Give a precise construction of these multi-orbit evaluation representations of $M=(\mathfrak{a}\otimes A)^\Gamma$ using the comultiplication $\Delta$.
(b) Classify, up to isomorphism, the irreducible representations of $M$ that arise as such multi-orbit evaluation representations.
(c) Describe their structural properties (e.g., conditions for irreducibility, when two such representations are isomorphic, behavior of tensor products, and the relation to single-orbit evaluation representations).
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open direction in the survey of equivariant map algebras: in the associative bialgebra setting, the comultiplication permits defining multi-orbit evaluation representations, but their construction, classification, and structural properties have not been worked out in the literature. No follow-up paper resolving this appears in the search results.

status_evidence.title: A survey of equivariant map algebras with open problems
status_evidence.snippet: In the case that a is an associative bialgebra, one can naturally define multi-orbit evaluation representations using the comultiplication on a. It would be interesting to understand these representations.
status_evidence.claim: The construction and study of multi-orbit evaluation representations for equivariant map algebras with associative bialgebra targets is proposed as an open direction.

status_evidence.title: Irreducible finite-dimensional representations of equivariant map algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Classification of irreducible finite-dimensional representations of equivariant map algebras in the Lie setting via evaluation representations.
status_evidence.claim: Existing classification results address the Lie algebra case; the associative bialgebra multi-orbit case remains separate and is not classified here.
